about: Kyr's judgement of each Orsino rule feature. faithful: same meaning as the Orsino source. adapted: Kyr executes a related mechanic whose different semantics are documented here. cosmetic: no mechanical effect in Orsino. unsupported: no executable Kyr meaning. Features not listed are unsupported. A trailing * matches a prefix.

effect:damage: Rolled per target, then the handleHit pipeline; a resisted spell halves or negates it.
effect:heal: Orsino handleHeal: + bonusHealing, at least 1, capped at missing HP. mayBeHealed is not executed.
effect:buff: Applies a catalogued or inline-defined status for the effect's duration (default 3), replacing an earlier one.
effect:debuff: Save (DC saveDC or 15, + caster level + bonusSpellDC) against the effect's or status's save kind; skipped for a target that resisted the spell.
effect:removeStatus: Removes statuses by key or display name, including "a|b" patterns.
effect:attack: Fighting.attack: THAC0 − AC − to-hit, natural 1 misses, critical range, evasion; weapon die + critical + STR/DEX modifier; hooks. Spillover rolls its next target from the seeded stream.
effect:drain: Deals typed damage and heals the actor by the damage actually dealt; Orsino heals the full rolled amount.
effect:kill: Reduces a living target to zero hit points.
effect:resurrect: Kyr revive restores a rolled amount of HP; Orsino hpPercent and template application are not modelled.
effect:gold: Kyr gain of the gold resource.
effect:xp: Kyr gain of the experience resource.
effect:learn: Kyr learn adds a catalogued ability permanently.
effect:summon: Legacy encounter-local summon of a catalogued creature; no persistent campaign ownership.
flag:saveDC: Debuff DC = saveDC + caster level + bonusSpellDC.
flag:saveForHalf: Each target of an offensive spell saves vs magic at 15 + bonusSpellDC first; a success halves this damage.
flag:saveNegates: As saveForHalf; a success negates this damage.
target:enemies: Every living opponent in the encounter. Kyr battles are not spatial.
modifier:bonusDamage: Added to every hit the holder deals to another creature, rolled when it is dice.
modifier:noActions: The holder loses its turn, and its turn-end effects with it.
modifier:resistFire: Fractional resistance, added to resistAll; above 1 still leaves nothing, below 0 amplifies.
modifier:resistCold: Fractional resistance, added to resistAll; above 1 still leaves nothing, below 0 amplifies.

weapon:natural: A species' weapon: its melee attack; it cannot be dropped, sold or equipped.
field:backgroundModifier.str: Added to the generated score, as Orsino's overlay addition.
field:backgroundModifier.gp: Kyr divides Orsino gold by ten for its local coin economy.
field:backgroundModifier.requiredClass: Validated at creation; a character of another class cannot take the background.
field:backgroundModifier.startingGear: Item instances in the character's pack, where the gear kind exists in the Kyr item catalog.
field:classModifier.hitDie: Level 1: hit die + positive CON modifier; above level 1, Orsino's NPC formula.
field:masterWeapon.type: Exact damage type where Kyr has the type.
field:masterEquipment.type: The damage type of weapon-class equipment (exact where Kyr has the type); a catalog grouping otherwise.
field:masterEquipment.effect: Judged by the modifier features of the effect.

field:monsterStat.*: Composed by OrsinoMonsters exactly as the monster template does; the resulting scores are used with Kyr's statMod.
field:monsterTypeModifier.*: As monsterStat; overlay traits become passive traits.
field:monsterXp: Kyr encounterXp of the installed creature.
field:monsterTraits: Passive traits of the creature kind; each trait is judged by its own features.
field:monsterAbilities: Abilities of the creature's calling; each ability is judged by its own features.
field:monsterWeapon: The species' natural weapon, used by its melee attack.
field:dragonColors.weapon: The colour's breath weapon replaces the natural weapon, as in the template; see weapon:breath.
field:monsterKind: Names the types a monster class can take.
field:monsterTypeClass: Links a type to its class.
field:monsterRank.maxHp: The template overlays a maxHp field that Orsino's combatant never reads; hit points are unchanged.
field:monsterRank.ac: Overlaid as an ac field that Orsino's combatant never reads.
weapon:breath: Orsino never reads this flag: breath weapons attack one target through melee. Kyr makes a breath weapon an area effect on every opponent, with a breath-category save for half and a recharge.
field:golemSubstances.*: Applied by OrsinoMonsters as the substance overlay, in template order.
flag:condition: Ability conditions on a status or an intercepting weapon, and effect conditions on a trait, are checked; notStatus and dead are not.
modifier:toHit: Added to the attack roll's to-hit.
modifier:ac: Added to armour class (lower is better).
modifier:evasion: A hit is evaded on d20 ≥ 20 − evasion.
modifier:allRolls: Added to every d20 the holder rolls (attack, save, initiative, evasion), floored at 1. Orsino may also add it to damage dice rolled through Deem.
modifier:str: Added to the effective score for every check that reads it.
modifier:dex: Added to the effective score for every check that reads it.
modifier:con: Added to the effective score for every check that reads it.
modifier:int: Added to the effective score for every check that reads it.
modifier:wis: Added to the effective score for every check that reads it.
modifier:cha: Added to the effective score for every check that reads it.
modifier:bonusSpellDC: Added to spell and debuff DCs.
modifier:tempHp: A pool rolled when the status is applied; it absorbs damage first and ends with the status.
modifier:initiative: Added to each round's initiative roll.
modifier:damageReduction: Subtracted from every non-true hit after resistance.
modifier:compelNextMove: The holder must use that ability while it can.
modifier:forceTarget: The holder must target whoever applied the status while that creature stands.
modifier:onTurnEnd: Damage or healing at the end of the holder's turn (or each world-time tick).
modifier:onAttackHit: Effects on the creature the holder hits.
modifier:onAttacked: Effects when another creature damages the holder.
modifier:onMissReceived: Effects when an attack misses the holder.
target:attacker: The creature that triggered a hook.
weapon:missile: Missile weapons attack with DEX and are offered as ranged.
weapon:intercept: Checked as Set Spear's condition; the spear's reaction to a charge is not executed.
field:masterArmor.natural: Natural armour is a species' armour, never worn as an item.
field:classModifier.weaponProficiencies: Checked when equipping, not for starting gear (as in Orsino).
field:classModifier.armorProficiencies: Checked when equipping, not for starting gear (as in Orsino).
field:classModifier.traitChoices: One specialization chosen (or drawn) at creation, minus the ancestry's forbidden traits.
field:abilities: The class's abilities, known from creation; defend is the core ability and melee or ranged comes from the weapon.
field:weapon: The starting weapon is drawn from the class's table.
field:armor: The starting armour is drawn from the class's table.
field:racialModifier.evil: An evil ancestry is not playable.
field:traits: An ancestry's racial traits, with humanoid, are given at birth.
flag:spillover: Lethal excess damage carries to another living enemy, chosen from the seeded stream rather than Math.random.
